Unfolding the map…

DESSCOVER beta

Welcome to The Digital Dessau.

Twenty-six landmarks, from a Renaissance palace wing to two shopping centres, across the city and out to Wörlitz. Choose one on the map to open it in 3D, then click around it to uncover its history. Zoom out to see Mosigkau and Wörlitz.

News from Dessau

    My passport

      Each landmark has one question. It pops up once you have seen all its stories; answer it right to earn the stamp. Your passport is kept in this browser.

      About

      DESSCOVER beta is developed by Eslam ElShamy, an architect and designer based in Dessau.

      It brings the city's landmarks together on one map, as 3D models you can explore across time, walk through and redesign, with stories drawn from the sources cited on every card. The models are reconstructions from published dimensions, photographs and descriptions, so some details are approximate.

      Built with three.js. Base map: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Models drawn for this project.
